root_cause.text: Missing of_node_put() call for the device_node reference obtained from of_parse_phandle() in mc_probe(), causing a reference count leak on all function exit paths.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states "The original code never freed r5_core_node on any exit path, causing a memory leak." The patch adds the __free(device_node) attribute to ensure automatic cleanup, confirming the leak was present in the original code.

This error message is printed before the return, but no of_node_put() is called for the unreleased reference.
